title: Reinforce correct multiplication answers
summary: A GRPO-style loop in your process: sample a group per prompt, score it with reward.py, turn the scores into advantages with advantage.py, update. Swap or edit any of the four slots.

evidence.basis: live run r-261029-035938-9a84 of this template
evidence.note: One live run on 2026-10-29 with the defaults (6 steps, 8 prompts x 4 samples): mean reward 0.44 to 0.81, held-out 9 to 15 of 16, about 41 s per step. A single run: how much of the rise is sampling noise is not measured. Three more default runs that day: 9 to 14, 9 to 12 and 11 to 11; the base model's own held-out score varied between 9 and 11. Every other slot variant ran live once on 2026-11-02 with the other settings at their defaults ($0.0013 to $0.0017 each): batch_norm trained every group and cost the most ($0.00173); ppo and cispo returned no rollout_corr metrics; rebind_every 2 and 4 left the sampler 1 and up to 3 updates behind, with the KL reaching 0.07 and 0.17, and 4 finished in 216 s, where the default runs took 303 to 316 s; format only still trained, raising the share of bare-number answers from 50% to 91%.

you_will_see: Your loop drawn as it runs: which block is executing, on which side of the API, and what it cost
Most of each step on the AWS side: about 24 s to save weights and rebind the sampler, 11 s to sample, 6 s per update (measured 2026-10-29)
A reward check on known answers before the session exists, then reward, groups with signal and sampler-trainer KL per step

params.label: Rebind the sampler every
params.help: Steps between save_weights_and_get_sampling_client calls; 1 keeps sampling on-policy.

params.label: Max tokens per completion
params.help: The service minimum is 512; lower values are raised to 512.

variants.label: Exact match
variants.summary: 1 when the first number is the product, else 0.
variants.watch: Reward and held-out accuracy rise together.

variants.label: Partial credit
variants.summary: 1 for the product; a wrong number earns up to 0.5 for digits in the right place.
variants.watch: All-wrong groups are no longer all-equal, so they can give a gradient too. Live (one run) all-wrong groups were rare, and about as many groups gave a gradient as with exact.

variants.label: Format only
variants.summary: 1 for any bare number. Cannot tell right from wrong.
variants.watch: The reward check warns. Live, about half the first answers were not bare numbers, so it still trained, toward bare numbers.

variants.label: Group-normalized (GRPO)
variants.summary: (reward - group mean) / group std, per prompt; all-equal groups are skipped.
variants.watch: Same as the cookbook's grouped advantages.

variants.label: Group mean, unscaled
variants.summary: reward - group mean, per prompt, without dividing by the spread.
variants.watch: Same groups train; advantages keep the size of the reward differences.

variants.label: Batch baseline
variants.summary: (reward - batch mean) / batch std: the cookbook's Monte-Carlo + ReB for one turn.
variants.watch: All-equal groups train too: more train tokens and cost per step.

variants.label: importance_sampling
variants.summary: Policy gradient corrected by the trainer/sampler probability ratio.
variants.watch: Returns the rollout_corr/* metrics, so the sampler-trainer KL is charted.

variants.label: ppo
variants.summary: The same ratio, clipped. A policy loss only; there is no critic.
variants.watch: No rollout_corr/* metrics were published for ppo, so the KL chart stays empty.

variants.label: cispo
variants.summary: Clips the importance weight instead of the update.
variants.watch: The cookbook's multi-turn code RL used it. No KL chart, as with ppo.

variants.label: Every step
variants.summary: On-policy: every sample comes from the weights being trained.
variants.watch: About 20 s of each step is the rebind (measured).

variants.label: Every 2 steps
variants.summary: Every other step samples from weights one update old.
variants.watch: Half the rebinds and MODEL packages; the KL and 'behind' chart show the lag.

variants.label: Every 4 steps
variants.summary: Samples can be up to 3 updates behind the trainer.
variants.watch: Faster steps, more off-policy data for importance_sampling to correct.
